newsitem.title: JAPAN: Royal Co Ltd seen posting record profit.
newsitem.headline: Royal Co Ltd seen posting record profit.

text.p: Royal Co Ltd is expected to post a record parent current profit of about six billion yen in the year to December 31, 1996, a Japanese business daily said on Wednesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the expected rise in the restaurant operator's profits was because of improved sales due to better marketing and cost-cutting efforts.
A spokesman for Royal was not immediately available for comment.
The company posted an actual parent current profit of 4.27 billion yen in 1995.
